'''Stefan  Grigorievich Samko''' ({{langx|ru|Стефан Григорьевич Самко}}; born March 28, 1941) is a [[mathematician]] active in the field of [[functional analysis]], [[function spaces]] and [[operator theory]]. He is a retired professor of [[Mathematics]] at [[Algarve University]] and [[Rostov State University]].<ref>[http://www.hindawi.com/1983028/ Hindawi Author Biography]{{Dead link|date=May 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=no }}</ref>

== Career ==

===Research activity===
S. Samko has more than 260 research papers spread throughout the areas of,<ref>[http://www.ssamko.com/ Stefan Samko Home Page]</ref><ref>{{cite book | doi = 10.1007/978-3-0348-0516-2_1 | year=2013 | pages=1–48 | last1 = Kokilashvili | first1 = V. | title=Advances in Harmonic Analysis and Operator Theory | chapter=Stefan G. Samko – Mathematician, Teacher and Man | volume = 229| isbn=978-3-0348-0515-5 }}</ref>

*Harmonic Analysis and Operator Theory in Variable Exponent Function Spaces;
*Function spaces;
*Potential type operators;
*Hypersingualr integrals and the method of approximative inverse operators;
*Fractional calculus of one and many variables;
*Integral equations of the first kind (including multi-dimensional ones).

===Teaching activity===
